maya: heads up, prepping the EU change window snapshot for tomorrow 06:00 UTC. need to confirm which SLO dashboards + alerts we gate on.
kevin: p95 per-route, 5xx rate, error-budget-burn, kv-cache miss, embed-route p99, streaming tail latency. heatmap for sequence-length distribution.
nana: add reranker 4xx spikes and model-variant fallback counts. saw intermittent flakiness yesterday.
deploy-bot: preflight snapshot created by @maya: snap-20240322-02. dashboards captured: p95-latency, 5xx-rate, kvcache, embed-route, reranker. https://grafana.redwood/snap/snap-20240322-02
sre-bot: ALERT_SIM: embed-route p95 increased ~35% over baseline in last 30m (120ms -> 162ms). sample trace id=trace-8b4d.
kevin: any recent config or variant roll to staging/prod?
maya: quantize-v2.1.4-rc3 rolled to staging at 02:30 UTC, no prod rollout yet.
nana: pull trace logs: query trace-8b4d, looking for kernel fallbacks or KV latency.
kevin: logs show kernel fallback events on gpu-node-07 causing CPU tail latencies and sporadic 502s. KV fetches also stretched a bit.
maya: proposal: pin eu-embed to v2.1.4-rc2 for the change window until kernel regression checks complete. hold traffic shift.
nana: agree. add release note: "EU deploy delayed: pinned eu-embed to v2.1.4-rc2 pending runtime kernel regression for rc3"
deploy-bot: pin recorded by @maya: route=eu-embed, version=v2.1.4-rc2, reason="staging p95 spike with rc3". ticket RED-4219 created.
sre-bot: running smoke across pinned version: sample 2k reqs -> p95=116ms, 5xx=0.07%, kv-miss=2.1% -> smoke OK.
kevin: action items: 1) update release notes and changelog; 2) run kernel regression tests overnight on rc3, re-eval at 04:30 UTC.
maya: drafting release_notes: "2024-03-22 EU deploy: hold traffic shift for quantize-v2 until kernel regression completes. eu-embed pinned to v2.1.4-rc2. See RED-4219."
nana: ping platform-ops channel too so oncall sees it in the window.
kevin: added runbook snippet and the trace id to RED-4219. include rollback command for ops.
maya: final decision: no traffic shift until 05:00 UTC re-eval. If metrics stable then controlled ramp 10% -> 30% -> 60%. Abort if p95 > 1.25x baseline or 5xx > 0.5%.
deploy-bot: saved ramp_policy={10,30,60}, abort_criteria={p95>1.25x, 5xx>0.5%} on RED-4219.
sre-bot: tagging oncall: @kevin @ana please ack hold and monitor overnight tests. I'll post final snapshot at 04:30 UTC.
kevin: ack.
nana: ack. :thumbsup:
maya: adding unpin instructions to release notes PR: `deploy-bot pin remove --route eu-embed --version v2.1.4-rc2`
kevin: good. I'll follow up after regression runs.
(END)
